title: centaurea elegans
intro: Centaurea elegans, commonly known as mountain cornflower, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea elegans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects. The plant has also been found to possess antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
